title: Disable Win+X Power Shortcuts
name: disable-winx-power-shortcuts
description: Disable the Windows Win+X power menu shortcuts to prevent accidental shutdown and sign-out actions.
deepDescription: This tweak disables the Win+X power menu keyboard shortcuts (Shutdown, Restart, Sign out) while keeping the standard Win+X menu available. It is a reversible, safe registry change that helps avoid accidental power commands.
modal: This tweak disables the power shortcut keys on the Win+X menu to reduce accidental shutdowns or restarts. It can be reverted safely.
